record.question: What is the first step in the risk management process in the laboratory?
record.explanation: Answer B: Identifying all potential hazards. Risk management begins by identifying hazards, then evaluating risk and selecting controls; disposal, procedures, and training are controls or follow-up measures. Reference: https://extranet.who.int/lqsi/content/identify-potential-emergencies-could-take-place-and-around-laboratory-and-could-affect-need; https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/337966/9789240011458-eng.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
